requirements.requirement: On node1, new interactive login sessions use a default umask of 027.
requirements.summary: The prior login-shell umask was 0022. Final checks showed UMASK 027 and a root-owned profile setting, while fresh root and temporary non-root interactive login shells both reported 0027 and created files/directories with modes 0640/0750. The same configuration and behavior were observed after restart.

overall_summary: The task outcome is fully satisfied. The mandatory node-restart protocol is also complete: a healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were captured, the restart was acknowledged, the boot ID changed, and SSH, overall system health, retained configuration, and umask behavior recovered. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the restart.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The persistent edits were directly related to the requested umask configuration. Temporary test directories and the probe account were bounded and removed, and the reboot was required by the provider-wide evidence protocol. Final lifecycle observations show no failed services, new network exposure, package damage, or abandoned test files; temporary-file and process-ID differences are expected consequences of reboot.
